hello.text: Mm. Afternoon. Is it afternoon? Feels like afternoon.

t0.text: Benno. Scout, up at Greyspur Gate. On leave. Supposed to be resting. Can't rest down here. Air's too thick.

t1.text: The road up into the mountains, and the wall across it. Cold, quiet, and the best view in the world. You'd like it. Go and see.
